method: Open Pretest bugs at 00:00 Asia/Taipei on each Monday, counted in Jira with `status WAS NOT IN (Done, "Non-issue", "Ready for test", "Eng build", "Monitoring", "Ready for integration") ON <Monday 00:00> AND created < <Monday 00:00>`, over the ticket list as it stood on computed_at: both Round2 workbooks' BugList keys plus filter 12399 Bugs whose title has PCTS or Facet. CP and AA together, a ticket on both sides counted once. Written once by hand; the daily pretest snapshots in history.json take over from here.
split_method: Same instants and same 148-key scope as open_at, split by the status each ticket was in at that moment: red = `status WAS IN (Blocked, "To Do", Reopen) ON <Monday 00:00>`, yellow = `status WAS IN ("In Progress") ON <Monday 00:00>`, both with `AND created < <Monday 00:00>`. "other" is open_at minus those two — tickets sitting in an open status that is neither (Need info / Ready for review); it is not queried, it is the residual, and it is non-zero in only three weeks. Run by hand in Jira advanced search, 32 queries; every weekly red + yellow + other was checked against open_at before it was written here.
